title: The Most Extreme Explosion in the Universe
summary: A Kurzgesagt animation on supernovae, the most powerful explosions in the universe. It explains their role in creating elements and what would happen to Earth if one occurred nearby.
why: HN cites it for how unlikely supernovae are as extinction events and how distance determines their impact.

quote.text: supernovae turn out to be one of the least likely extinction scenarios. Their video on this points out why
